runtime_semantics.paper_live_action: persist portfolio_drawdown_halt and block new entries while allowing risk-reducing sells
runtime_semantics.resume: verified reconciliation plus operator risk-epoch reset rebasing the high-water mark
runtime_semantics.offline_action: record shadow event and continue alpha target/curve for drawdown-only breach

preexisting_evidence.meaning: offline drawdown_halt_shadow_events do not freeze the alpha curve; operational drawdown recovery is an explicit risk-epoch reset
production halts entries on drawdown; backtest records shadow events and keeps trading
historical offline max drawdown is reported and documented risks are not universal gates
historical economic acceptance used relative maxDD and operational shadow-day diagnostics, not a 5% absolute offline bound
